annotation.title_clean: К вопросу о формализации этики поведения коллаборативного робота
annotation.title_en: On the issue of formalization of collaborative robot ethical behavior
annotation.venue: Информационные и математические технологии в науке и управлении
annotation.summary_en: Russian journal article on mechanisms enabling a collaborative robot to be a moral agent. It argues that logics cannot fully formalize ethics, proposes utilitarianism with hedonistic axiology, uses cognitive maps, and states three principles of robot moral behavior centered on needs, perception, and self/other distinction.
key_provisions_or_claims: Logical schemes and non-classical logics cannot resolve formalization of ethics given inherent contradictions and incompleteness.
Moral schemes should provide an explanatory component for behavior, not just evaluate actions.
Utilitarianism (Bentham, Mill) combined with hedonism proposed as the ethical basis for robot behavior.
Moral behavior depends on current needs and perception state.
Morality rests on self/other (свой-чужой) comparison of conspecifics with the 'I'.
